question: With the middle-leg coxae held at the forward edge of their recorded walking range by a declared servo-equilibrium shift, does the closed hair-plate -> CNS -> coxa loop on joint_LMCoxa / joint_RMCoxa (H1) push each coxa back, and the sign-flipped binding push it further forward?
policy: C2 (falsification with sign reversal) step of the Part A CONDITIONAL tier only; a C2 pass makes the coordinate eligible for a separate C3 confirmation on CNS seeds 4-6; nothing becomes CONDITIONAL from this test.
design_correction_before_registration: The design text gave the bias change as biasprm[0] -= kp*Delta. For a MuJoCo position servo (force = kp*ctrl + biasprm[0] - kp*q) the equilibrium is ctrl + biasprm[0]/kp, so a shift of Delta requires biasprm[0] += kp*Delta; the declared quantity (equilibrium shift Delta, negative = forward) is unchanged. Corrected before any code ran.

sources.c0_note: coxa-admission-v1 raw arms C0_1..3 (local, uncommitted; hashes from docs/evidence/coxa-admission-v1/run/report.json)

displacement.rows: baseline position servos of joint_LMCoxa and joint_RMCoxa only (actuator IDs resolved from the bound inventory)
displacement.write: actuator_biasprm[aid, 0] = biasprm0 + kp*Delta with kp = actuator_gainprm[aid, 0]; refused unless kp > 0, biasprm[aid,0] == 0 and biasprm[aid,1] == -kp
displacement.expected_after_record: the original model record with exactly those two biasprm[aid, 0] entries replaced; compared exactly
displacement.rule: f* = f_max + (f_max - theta) = 0.20741358913376884 (Step B middle-leg tuning); Delta = (f* - f_rest) / (df/dCoxa), Step B rest_forward and axis_direction_per_0p1rad*10

arms.seed_mechanism: brain.rng = default_rng(seed) at attach, before the first neural transition (as coxa-admission-v1)
arms.P0: Step C A_ON + displacement; no hypothesis channel
arms.PC: P0 + H1 joint_LMCoxa, joint_RMCoxa only (hypothesis session path)
arms.PF: P0 + H1_FLIP of the same two channels

integrity.I2_common_rng_within_seed: identical per-tick uniforms and schedule within each seed
integrity.I3_reproduces_c0_prefix: P0_s equals coxa-admission C0_s in qpos through state 5005 and in fired, uniforms and hair deliveries for ticks at or before the event time
integrity.I4_displacement_verified: event at 5005, operation SHIFT_SERVO_EQUILIBRIUM, after sha == expected sha, declared Delta values, one expected sha across arms; model unchanged before the event (run-time check)
integrity.I5_channels_bounds: v3 inventories identical; P0 no hypothesis channel and LM/RM Coxa commands constant; PC/PF exactly the two channels with the declared hashes; |offset| <= 0.25 rad; other non-v3 commands equal P0
integrity.I6_prefix_within_seed: PC/PF equal P0 until their first coxa command
integrity.I7_seeds_applied: tick-1 uniforms differ between seeds; every arm records its seed

context_precondition: every P0_s has mean window hair-plate rate >= 30 Hz in both LM and RM; else INCONCLUSIVE_CONTEXT with no labels; the displacement is not changed

measures.df: mean coxa forward component (hair_forward, Step B geometry) in the window: arm minus P0_s, per middle leg

labels.seed_pass: df(PC_s) <= -0.02 and df(PF_s) >= +0.02 for that leg

flags.BOUND_LIMITED: offset within 0.01 rad of 0.25 in more than half of window samples in any PC/PF arm
flags.ROLLOVER: any sample with tilt > 90 deg in any arm
flags.NO_DRIVE: the PC command of the coordinate never changes in any seed

labels.reported_not_labelled: graded feedback: hair-plate rate PC vs P0 vs PF

consequence_declared_in_advance: C2_PASSED -> 'C2 passed, awaiting C3' in COXA_COORDINATE_STATUS.md, next a separately preregistered C3 on seeds 4-6 (on approval). C2_PARTIAL -> recorded, no status change. C2_NOT_SUPPORTED -> NOT_SUPPORTED for H1 in this context. NO_DRIVE -> recorded as an input limit. INCONCLUSIVE -> no status change. No weights, thresholds, gains, mappings or seeds change; coverage stays 20/42 admitted, +2 conditional.
interpretation_limits: Engineering perturbation: the displacement is imposed through the servo equilibrium; a probe stimulus, not a biological input or behaviour.
Assisted context; offset-on-servo actuation: a 'push back' is a setpoint shift.
One body model, three seeds that vary only stochastic sensory timing.
C2 step only; nothing becomes CONDITIONAL; not balance or gait.
